description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {U/B}.
When Memnite dies, Mortuary and Kels trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Memnite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Kels trigger, causing you to pay {U/B} to draw Memnite from the top of your library.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.
